name: specora
description: Specora: modern open-source OpenAPI documentation and workflow toolkit

scripts.build: npm run -w @specora/core build && npm run -w @specora/import-postman build && npm run -w @specora/embed-core build && npm run -w @specora/cli build && npm run -w @specora/api build && npm run -w @specora/web build
scripts.lint: npm run -w @specora/core lint && npm run -w @specora/import-postman lint && npm run -w @specora/embed-core lint && npm run -w @specora/cli lint && npm run -w @specora/api lint && npm run -w @specora/web lint
scripts.test: npm run -w @specora/core test && npm run -w @specora/import-postman test && npm run -w @specora/embed-core test && npm run -w @specora/cli test && npm run -w @specora/api test && npm run -w @specora/web test
